support.title: Support
support.faq_register_a: Tap «No account?», fill in name, email, phone and password (at least 8 characters). Then confirm your email with the code from the message.
support.faq_verify_q: I did not receive the verification code
support.faq_verify_a: Check your spam folder. The code expires — request a new one on the verification screen. Make sure the email address is correct.
support.faq_zone_q: How do I pick a zone and see the tariff?
support.faq_zone_a: On the map enable «Rental zones», tap the zone you need — the bottom panel shows the name and rates (₽/min, ₽/km, pause). Then choose an available car inside the zone.
support.faq_start_q: How do I start and finish a trip?
support.faq_start_a: Select a zone => car => confirm start. After booking tap «Start driving». To finish use «Finish» on the active trip panel. History is in your profile.
support.faq_network_q: I lost internet during a trip
support.faq_network_a: A warning appears at the top. Wait for connectivity and tap «Retry» on the error message. The server recalculates the price after a successful finish.
support.faq_contact_a: Call or email us below. Include your account email and when the issue happened — we will respond faster.
